# qik nexus pi — show current PI number

Use `mcp_qik-mcp_nexus_pi` or CLI:

```bash
qik nexus pi
```

Returns the current PI (Program Increment) counter. Read-only.
To close the current PI and start the next, use `mcp_qik-mcp_nexus_close`.
